question: Otto had a really rough childhood due to having a blessing, but does Julius also have any bad memories due to having the blessing that attracts spirits?
answer: Nothing in particular. Fortunately, the six quasispirits that became his contracted spirits were diligently guarding the young Julius. After that, Julius reached the age where he was prepared to make a contract, and with little more than a "Nice to meet you", the six quasispirits contracted with him.
